nodes.label: Server-Safe Components
nodes.rationale: Removing use client works because the server/client boundary was moved before removing the directive. Browser-only visual rendering lives in VisualEffects which is explicitly a Client Component.

nodes.label: Static Prerendering
nodes.rationale: Best case for this portfolio because the first screen mostly uses static portfolio copy and a predictable layout, so Next.js can generate the homepage at build time and the browser receives HTML immediately

nodes.label: Next.js Fit Rationale
nodes.rationale: Next.js is a good choice because Shellfolio is a hybrid experience: static portfolio content benefits from server rendering while terminal/WebGL needs browser interactivity. App Router lets these two worlds coexist with Server Components by default and use client only where browser state or effects are needed.
